title: Continuation doctrine
summary: Dev3 is natively qualified. Continue by adopting the stable interpolation surface in consumers where it removes ad-hoc templating, while keeping domain formatting and output authority outside StringTemplate.
priorities: Adopt StringTemplate from consuming components where it removes ad-hoc interpolation without weakening their escaping or authority contracts.
Keep domain formatting in domain-owned TemplateFormatter implementations rather than teaching StringTemplate about Units, time, money or application models.
Preserve deterministic binding: use explicit new-template rebinding rather than mutation that changes an existing template's meaning.
Keep requirement inspection non-executing so consumers can validate template dependencies before rendering.
If future literal syntax is proposed for ooRexx itself, preserve these library semantics first and treat language syntax as sugar over an already-defined contract.
avoid: template loops/conditionals/macros that create a second language
silent formatter rebinding of existing templates
claiming structural checks as runtime qualification
